function.name: system-stats
function.description: Collect local system diagnostics as a JSON report. Read-only. Use to assess machine resources or diagnose a slow workspace. Default sections: load,mem,disk; run ports/bench only on direct request or via explicit 'all'.

section.description: Which diagnostics to collect: a section name or a comma-separated list. Valid names: all, load, mem, disk, uptime, top, ports, bench. Default: 'load,mem,disk'. 'all' runs every section and cannot be combined.

top_n.description: Number of processes to include in the 'top' section (default 5, max 100)

mb.description: Megabytes to hash in the 'bench' section (default 64, max 1024)
